MRK.headline: Novavax's Second-Largest Shareholder Sells $32.6 Million in Stock, Ends Activist Push

MRK.headline: 9 Of 11 Sectors Rise In Friday Trading As Cyclicals Lead
MRK.summary: Nine of 11 sectors are higher in Friday’s regular session, with cyclical sectors holding the top three positions. The leaders are separated rather than clustered, with no single gap clearly standing apart from the other breaks across the table.

MRK.headline: Nike, Moderna, Walmart Get a Lift as Traders Flee AI Stocks
MRK.summary: Concerns about tech companies overspending on AI prompted investors to rotate out of the trade and seek value elsewhere.

MRK.headline: Defensives Lead Sectors In Thursday Trading As Technology Trails
MRK.summary: Seven sectors are higher and four are lower in Thursday’s regular session, with defensive sectors holding two of the top three positions. The leaders are separated rather than clustered, with Health Care sitting well above the next group.

MRK.headline: Nasdaq 100 Drops 1% on Hot CPI, SOXX Falls 7th Day: Stock Market Today

MRK.headline: Why Is BioNTech Stock Falling Tuesday?
